list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY build_version

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'encounter') AS encounter, count() AS battles, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'turns')) AS turns, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'damage_taken')) AS damage FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='encounter_completed') GROUP BY encounter LIMIT 1000

SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'card_name') AS card, count() AS plays FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='card_played') GROUP BY card LIMIT 1000

SELECT avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'turn')) AS destruction_turn, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'remaining')) AS remaining FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='obelisk_destroyed') LIMIT 1000
